sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Climb Hero are simple yet addictive. Players guide a climber to the top of a mountain by selecting the right stones at the right time. The game features a variety of stones, each with its own weight and speed. The goal is to select the right stones to reach the top of the mountain without running out of time or falling off.

The gameplay is fast-paced and requires quick reflexes and strategic thinking. Players must carefully select the right stones to navigate the mountain's treacherous terrain. The game also features a variety of obstacles, including rocks, pitfalls, and other hazards that can hinder progress.

One of the unique features of Climb Hero is its use of a timing-based mechanic. Players must time their stone selections perfectly to maintain momentum and avoid obstacles. This requires a deep understanding of the game's physics and timing, making it challenging but rewarding to play.

The game also features a variety of power-ups and bonuses that can aid players in their quest to reach the top of the mountain. These power-ups can be used to increase speed, avoid obstacles, or even skip entire levels. However, they must be used strategically to maximize their effectiveness.
